metadata.title: The Discrete Monotonicity Property in Rank Two
metadata.abstract: The Betke--Henk--Wills conjecture predicts a bound for lattice-point counts in terms of successive minima. Malikiosis introduced the discrete monotonicity property for normalized residue counts as a sufficient condition for this bound and its extension to nonsymmetric convex bodies. We prove that every compact convex set satisfies this property for lattice subgroups of rank at most two, in arbitrary ambient dimension.

analysis.progressType: 低秩格子子群的离散单调性
analysis.workSummary: 对任意环境维数中的每个紧凸集，证明其对秩至多二的格子子群满足归一化剩余类计数的离散单调性。该性质是 Malikiosis 为 Betke–Henk–Wills 格点计数猜想及非对称推广引入的充分条件。
techniques: 逐次极小相关的离散单调性
analysis.breakthrough: 在环境维数不受限时完成秩二子群层面的单调性。
analysis.limitations: 限制在格子子群秩至多二，不能写成任意秩的离散单调性或全维 Betke–Henk–Wills 猜想均已证明。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 几何数论的基础进展明确，与曲率分析主线联系相对有限。
